segments.ja: 昨日までの森は、ジークを輪で見る場所でした。でした。今日の輪は、内側から崩れています。崩れる兵は、瓶を飲んだ人です。飲んだ人が、一声のあとで人間の形を保ちません。保たない音を、リヴァイは確認の終わりとして走ります。走る目的は、次の一声を出させないことです。出させない距離まで、彼は木のあいだを一直線に進みます。進む足は、倒れた兵の名を呼びません。
segments.en: Until yesterday, the forest was a place to watch Zeke from a ring. It was. Today's ring is collapsing from the inside. The soldiers who collapse are the people who drank the bottles. After one call, the people who drank do not keep a human shape. Levi runs the sound of not keeping it as the end of confirmation. The purpose of running is not to let the next call out. He goes in a straight line between the trees up to the distance of not letting it out. The feet that advance do not call the names of the fallen.

segments.en: Zeke's smile changes its use in the moment Levi closes the distance. The use it changes to is not the margin of a plan. It is flight. Before the flight, he has one more call left. Levi does not let the back that throws go. The detail of the blade that does not let it go is not counted here.

segments.en: The soldiers who became Titans are not waiting for orders. The bodies that are not waiting head toward people who were colleagues until yesterday. The reason they head there is not hatred. It is the after of the call. The forest of the after does not return even if a name is called. The soldiers who survived understand the does not return while running. The speed of understanding is the speed of flight. Inside the speed, guns aim at humans. There are places where the opponent they aim at is already not human.

While chasing the one, he does not pick up the names of the soldiers who fell. He thinks the coldness of not picking them up is today's work. The work he thinks is a short blade, trees, and a body that falls. Each time a body falls, the smile of the plan grows distant. Even at the destination of growing distant, Zeke does not throw away the hour of meeting his younger brother. That hour remains deep in the forest.

segments.en: Floch carries the rightness he distributed at the harbor as far as the entrance of the forest. The soldiers he carries it with say they are the side that protects Eren. The guns of the side they say aim not at the corps commander but at the people who will not allow the meeting with the older brother. On the place they aim, there are soldiers keeping Hange's orders. The clash that is there is a savagery separate from the ring of Titans. Armin tries to stop the separate savagery. The voice that tries to stop it is small between the guns of both sides. Even with a small voice, he keeps calling his friend's name.

To the report that is there, she issues an order to stop. The order she issues arrives late to the ears of Floch's soldiers. Before it arrives, guns are already aiming at humans. The paper of a commander cannot stop the savagery that is aiming. Hange sets the responsibility that cannot be stopped on her own seat. The seat she sets it on is a continuation of the seat that refused the road at the meeting.

segments.en: Pyxis has not brought a cannon to this forest. He has not. What he holds is last night's water and a question only. The only question was what he would do with the island after meeting the older brother. It was, but in the forest it is already the after of meeting. The answer of the after is still absent.
